blocks.title: Search everything. Then the news.
blocks.lead: Glance is one screen: a search bar on top that finds everything on the phone, the way the Sesame launcher does, and the news under it, the way Google News shows it. It runs on any Android phone as a standalone app, and on Etesian it is built into the ROM and joins the launcher. Open source, AGPL-3.0-only.

paragraphs: The screenshots on this page are the Glance app on an Android emulator, with made-up stories, outlets, pictures, contacts, messages and files. None of it is real news or real people.

blocks.heading: The news
paragraphs: Open Glance and the news is there under the search bar, in two parts. Top stories are Google News’s own picks for the phone’s language and country. For you is ranked on the phone from what you read. Each story has a picture, the outlet, how long ago it was published, how many outlets cover it and its topic. Pull down, or tap Refresh on the bottom bar, to fetch it again.

items.title: Google News without the app
items.text: Its public RSS feeds: Top stories and the topics you pick (World, Your country, Business, Technology, Science, Health, Sports, Entertainment), for the phone’s language and country or an edition you choose. No app, no ads, no tracking scripts.

items.title: One story, many outlets
items.text: Articles about the same thing are merged into one story, and the number of outlets covering it counts towards its rank.

items.title: Ranked on the phone
items.text: A story ranks by how fresh it is (half-life 8 hours), how many outlets cover it, whether it comes from your own feeds or keywords, and what you open. Topics, outlets and words you read count more; Fewer like this counts less; both fade over two weeks.

items.title: Pictures for every story
items.text: Lent by publishers’ own feeds when they cover the same story, or read from the article page’s own picture.

items.title: Your feeds and keywords
items.text: Your own subscriptions, and keywords whose news comes first in For you. Yahoo News headlines can be mixed in; the same story shows once. On Etesian, the Feeds app’s subscriptions are mixed in too.

items.title: Forget what I read
items.text: What Glance learns stays on the phone, and one setting clears it.

blocks.heading: Search
paragraphs: Type a few letters and Glance looks everywhere at once, best matches first, each source’s results appearing as it answers. Matching works like Sesame’s: the start of the name, the start of any word, initials (gm finds Google Maps), or several words each starting a word (ma ka finds Maria Karra); letters in order only as a last resort. Enter opens the first result. Back clears the search and brings the news back.

images.alt: Searching for ma: Applications, Contacts, Files, Notifications, Messages and a web search row
images.caption: One query, every source: apps, contacts, files, notifications from the last 30 days, text messages and the web.

items.title: Applications
items.text: Every app, in every profile.

items.title: Contacts
items.text: By name, nickname or number. Needs the Contacts permission.

items.title: Messages
items.text: Text messages, and every message in chat notifications (WhatsApp, Signal and others). Needs SMS and notification access.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: All notifications of the last 30 days, kept after they are dismissed, so you can find what you swiped away. Needs notification access; the history can be cleared in Settings.

items.title: Settings
items.text: The Settings pages people look for: Wi-Fi, Battery, Developer options and more.

items.title: Files
items.text: By name. Needs all-files access.

items.title: News
items.text: Today’s stories and the Feeds app’s posts; a news result opens in the reader.

items.title: App shortcuts
items.text: What apps publish: a chat with someone, a new event. wa ma finds Maria in WhatsApp. Only on Etesian, as it needs the system’s permission.

items.title: Web
items.text: The query in your search engine, DuckDuckGo by default. Suggestions as you type are off by default.

blocks.heading: The reader
paragraphs: Stories open in Glance’s own reader, built on Mozilla Readability, the library behind Firefox’s reader view: the headline, the outlet, the picture and the text, without the rest of the page. The bottom bar has Back, Open in browser, Share and a menu with Larger text and Smaller text. When a page can’t be shown as an article, Glance says so and shows the page as it is. The reader can be switched off in Settings, and then stories open in the browser.

blocks.heading: Settings
paragraphs: Settings lists every search source with a switch, so each can be left out; a switch stays off until Android allows what it needs. News settings choose the reader, Google News and its topics and edition, and lead to Feeds and keywords.

items.title: Add a feed
items.text: Type a feed’s address (RSS or Atom), or just a site that has one, and Glance finds the feed.

items.title: OPML
items.text: Import subscriptions from another reader, or export them.

items.title: Keep for offline reading
items.text: Per subscription, and for Yahoo News: new articles are saved on Wi-Fi, not in battery saver, kept 30 days and up to 50 MB, and the reader opens them without a connection.

items.title: Nothing typed leaves the phone
items.text: Unless web suggestions are switched on: then what you type goes to DuckDuckGo for suggestions. A web search goes to your search engine only when you choose it.

items.title: Permissions only when asked
items.text: Contacts, messages, notifications and files are each asked for separately, from a card at the top, and each can be left off.

items.title: Learned on the phone
items.text: Reading interests and the notification history are stored on the phone only.

blocks.heading: With the Etesian launcher
paragraphs: On Etesian, Glance is built into the ROM from source and signed with the ROM’s platform key. That lets it share a permission with the launcher, which then shows the News view (Settings → Home screen views → News puts the news left of the other views, with each story’s picture) and Glance’s results under the apps in the Applications search. The launcher opens results through Glance, the only app able to start app shortcuts, fire notifications’ own actions and lend its file access. With the platform key Glance can also show app shortcuts and switch on its own notification access.
This needs an Etesian build with Glance built in.

blocks.heading: Standalone or in the ROM
paragraphs: The standalone APK from the Glance releases installs on any Android phone and is signed with Glance’s own key. Everything above works except app shortcuts and the launcher integration, which need the ROM’s platform key. The ROM’s copy is built from the same source and signed with the ROM’s keys, so the two are separate installs; on Etesian you don’t need the APK.
